Alex Chen: PTAL — I addressed the requested changes on the scheduler debounce logic. Short summary:
- reduced default debounce from 200ms -> 120ms
- fixed race when timer is reset during drain
- added unit tests for timer drift and jitter
- updated CHANGELOG and added migration note for config key `scheduler.debounce_ms`

Code snippet:
```
if (timer.reset()) {
  // preserve remaining window
  timer.set(Math.min(rem, config.debounce_ms))
}
```

Megan O'Neill: nice, will skim. did you run the staging smoke with high qps?

Alex Chen: ran quick smoke (5m) with canary fwd; no regressions locally. CI still running full matrix.

Samir Patel: thanks — can you add a test for the case where a queued job is canceled while debounce active? that was the original bug.

Alex Chen: good call — added cancel-path test in scheduler_test.go: TestDebounceCancel

Jordan Kim: timeline: when do you want this merged? We have a merge window at 11:30 PT, otherwise it'll wait for next slot.

Alex Chen: if CI green by 11:15 I'll merge and request canary. otherwise will re-queue for next window.

CI Bot: CI started: unit-tests (linux), integration (staging), linters.

Megan O'Neill: also pls add a short note in the rollout doc about rollback marker (we had to roll back last time).

Alex Chen: added rollback instructions under docs/rollouts/scheduler.md

CI Bot: unit-tests passed (1719010450). integration still running.

Samir Patel: lgtm for the unit-tests changes, will watch canary once merged.

Alex Chen: thanks — PTAL again @Megan @Jordan when you get a sec. :thumbsup:
